articles.summary: Intellicheck CEO Bryan Lewis joins FreightWaves Today on July 6, 2026, to discuss the rise in identity theft and its connection to the ongoing cargo theft crisis affecting the freight and logistics industry. Lewis shares insights on how identity verification technology can help combat fraud and protect supply chains from bad actors exploiting stolen identities.
